column1: # The emulator rows measured on 2026-11-08 (rows2), each line as its pinning test logged it (CosmosWitnessProbe), run against
# mcr.microsoft.com/cosmosdb/linux/azure-cosmos-emulator:vnext-preview, release EN20261019: case mapping over cased letters of
# each band, RIGHT with its cut inside a surrogate pair, LIKE's _ and % over one character of each class, a ] closing nothing
# and a backslash with no ESCAPE, and CONTAINS and a one-run LIKE over U+0000. A function's answer is the projection; a
# truth's is value/kept. Release EN20260907 answered every line alike; both refuse the lone surrogate the LIKE test also
# sends, so no line holds it.
